message: 野望のスウィーツ王国

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's impossible~ Let's just drop it~」

name: Synn
message: 「What's this all of a sudden?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Nah, believe it or not, I actually love baseball.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True, it's more complicated than I thought... *sigh*...」

name: Eddie
message: 「No way, baseball's easy! As long as you remember not to run toward third base, you'll be fine.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I can't think of anything~ Or rather, I just remembered I wasn't thinking about anything at all~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Figures as much」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's so mean~」

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth are you guys talking about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you see. I was thinking about participating in the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, participating? The Student Council is the organizer.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean participating as the Sweets Club」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. Voluntary participation.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Stuff like that isn't meant to be participated in, it's meant to be enjoyed~」

name: Eddie
message: 「That's where you're wrong! Watching baseball is great and all, but its true value comes from actually playing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already got the application forms, too, but there's all sorts of annoying stuff to deal with.」

name: Eddie
message: 「Anyone looking to join the club is welcome anytime!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eddie, nobody here is talking about baseball.」

name: Eddie
message: 「What?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ever since Nana-chan joined the Student Council, our club activities have already been in a slump anyway~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the one who told me to join!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~? Did I really~?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san! Could you return my English dictionary?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, sorry, sorry. Here you go」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? These documents are--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just a little something」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's reckless. Your head is gonna explode」

name: Misa
message: 「Why don't you just participate?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I do intend to, though. Just not sure what I should do......」

name: Synn
message: 「As Student Council President, I'd be happy if you joined in」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think the more people who participate, the more dazzling and fun the event will be」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, you traitor」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right here, to an undecided Nana―chan―」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'If you participate, Nanaka, our already scarce time together will shrink even more'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Is what you're supposed to say」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that supposed to be me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Sounded just like you, right?」

name: Everyone
message: 「No, not at all」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Adding a passionate baiser before saying it makes it super effective」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't do anything like that in front of me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You won't, huh. What a shame, Nana-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How am I supposed to answer that! Take this for spouting weird nonsense!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nooo, not the pickled plum! My brain, which is already as soft as chestnut paste, is gonna melt into mush」

name: Misa
message: 「Why don't you participate? You might be able to get promoted from a society to an official club」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah, that's actually what I was thinking」

name: Paqy
message: 「So that's your motive」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugyaa, crap!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well... assuming you can manage some standout activities, that is」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Vice Presideeent? Why are you looking at my face?」

name: Misa
message: 「Assuming you can, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're doing it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Doing whaaat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you frustrated?! Don't you want to show Misa up?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Not really」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We are definitely getting promoted, you hear me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good luck」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You too, obviously」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think there's any rule about getting promoted like that, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! When I say we're doing it, we're doing it!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what are you actually going to do?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's... something I'll figure out now!」
